state.accepted: An immutable server receipt/read supplies documentId, revision, artifact, mode, sourceHash, policyVersion and provenance. Only successful COMMITTED receipt or authorized GET updates accepted snapshot; parser diagnostics never do. Keep historical accepted snapshots distinct from current head.
state.draft: Separate immutable draftId, monotone draftEpoch, baseRevision, mode, candidate, selectedNodeId/role, diagnostics, dirty indicator and pending exact request bytes/key. Browser-only holes never enter wire accepted module. Preserve draft after rejection, stale response or availability. Invalid text never replaces accepted source. Keep monotone contentGeneration separately from presentation epoch: selection-only changes invalidate diagnostics but do not change source content.
state.pending: Before sending a mutation retain exact serialized UTF-8 body, method,route,key and originating draft epoch. In-session uncertain retry resends byte-identical body/key. On browser restart fetch authorized head; unresolved pending request is recovered only if exact bytes were retained, otherwise show receipt recovery status without fabricating resubmission. Local storage of private model bodies is opt-in; server durable receipts remain authority.
state.freshness: Every edit, selection, bounds change, document switch and undo/redo increments presentation epoch. Validation diagnostics bind document/draftId/epoch/baseRevision and requestHash of exact whole serialized validation request; browser compares retained exact request identity to current candidate before applying proposedSource/hash or inverse-remapped diagnostic IDs. SOURCE additionally compares exact source hash. BLOCK preview source comes only from matching response, not a guessed browser printer. Source navigation rechecks artifact/epoch/hash at activation. A late commit may update known head/history but never replace newer draft or restore its evidence; accepted head never decreases.

palette.editors: Named declaration editors use exact server/draft IDs, names, multiplicities, field owner/range columns, ordered set-valued parameters, body roots and explicit command options. Signature picker lists known nominal types; variable picker lists only lexical ancestors and current predicate parameters. Parameter arity and all dependent uses are recomputed after edits. Every palette item has pointer and keyboard insertion with a visible label.
palette.slots: Each destination displays formula or exact ordered nominal schema where known. Unknown constraints display a specific relation constraint, never a guessed type: union/intersection/difference/equality/subset require equality to resolved sibling; product concatenates schemas; join reports left-last=right-first and result nonempty/width<=8. A hole is an explicit unresolved draft constraint. Preview may allow unresolved constraints but must reject known contradictions, out-of-scope variables, moving into descendants and stale source payloads. Completion revalidates whole module.
palette.errors: Show failing node/role and reason including expected/actual nominal schema or missing binder/declaration. Declaration changes may invalidate multiple dependents; retain draft and list bounded diagnostics. No forced cast, silent deletion, implicit variable capture or parser-success accepted badge.

operations.create_connect: Select a declaration body/child slot, choose or drag a compatible palette item and fill explicit fields. Browser allocates draft UUIDs. New holes keep draft incomplete. Accepted save disabled while any hole or known contradiction remains; server independently validates all complete candidates.
operations.move: Drag or Cut then Paste an existing owned subtree using documentId, baseRevision,draftId,contentGeneration,nodeId identity. Preserve node/binder IDs, reject stale payloads/descendant cycles and variable escape/capture, then revalidate destination and every dependent. Movement modifies draft only until server commit. Selection-only destination changes preserve clipboard eligibility; actual source edit/deletion, document switch or accepted-base change invalidates or explicitly rechecks snapshot. No relaxed diagnostic epoch checks.
operations.copy: Copy then Paste allocates fresh draft IDs for every owned expression/binder, remaps internal bound references capture-avoidably and preserves external declaration references. External bound variable references must remain in scope. Attach explicit presentationCopies for each old expression to new expression so server transfers comments; compatible-kind mapping authorizes comments only. Clipboard stores optional accepted-base comment provenance separately from IDs. New draft-only nodes emit no transfer. Copy-of-copy propagates original authorized accepted-base source ID to new destinations; never send draft sourceNodeId. Accepted-base change clears/rebases provenance explicitly with notice; no text matching.
operations.delete: Replace expression with browser-only hole or delete selected declaration explicitly. Retain dependency failures visibly; server prevents invalid accepted modules. Comments deleted by block changes become server-visible trailing orphans.
operations.history: Undo/Redo selects explicit retained target revision; submit history-copy with current head expectedRevision, new idempotency key and direction. Server revalidates as fresh artifact/revision. Show preview of target before explicit action when unsaved draft would be replaced; retain newer unsaved draft on late success. Navigation never mutates previous history. Show exact target revision/artifact; keep explicit navigation cursor separate from latest head, so Redo never guesses a global inverse.
operations.rename: Change display name through declaration editor; declaration identities/types remain explicit. Reprint and reparse full source server-side; names/UUIDs never enter canonical embeddings.
operations.text: Edit exact source independently. Validate and save supported source to BLOCK_SUPPORTED with new mapped IDs, unsupported parser-accepted source to TEXT_ONLY. Show text-only status clearly; no fabricated blocks. Switching to blocks requires actual supported elaboration or explicit complete block candidate.

accessibility.controls: Use native labeled buttons, inputs, selects and landmarks; keyboard insertion and list navigation never depend on dragging. Focus selected node/slot after successful draft operation, nearest surviving parent or declaration after delete, and failed control after rejection. Report operation/constraint/commit outcomes in a polite live region; errors are programmatically associated.
accessibility.shortcuts: Offer visible Copy, Cut, Paste, Delete, Undo and Redo buttons plus Ctrl/Cmd+C/X/V, Delete, Ctrl/Cmd+Z and Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z while focus is in the block editor. Do not intercept typing, native text selection or input undo in source/name fields. Escape cancels pending move/palette interaction. Standard Tab/Shift+Tab access every action.
manual_scenarios: Keyboard-only create signatures/field/predicate/parameters and each operator family; fill/drop typed slots with visible constraints.
Pointer and keyboard move/copy a quantified subtree: fresh binders for copy, preserved IDs for move, denied escaping variable.
Save, concurrent stale edit, lost acknowledgement/retry and restart: accepted revision authority distinct from preserved draft.
Repeated references, non-BMP and CRLF source-map navigation; delayed validation after selection/edit cannot move current focus or badge evidence.
Copy/move/delete comments and visible orphan notices; undo/redo as new revision preserves historical source.
TEXT_ONLY to supported source and back; invalid drafts leave accepted artifact visible.
accessibility.named_assistive_technology: Firefox ESR with Orca on Linux, plus Chromium keyboard-only; record actual browser/AT versions and observed outcomes. These are required manual scenarios, not evidence from component tests.
accessibility.automation: Automated accessibility scans and component behavior tests supplement named manual runs. Browser extension availability does not establish WCAG compliance.

performance.fixture: Deterministic balanced forest with500 expression nodes, exact nominal declarations, depth<=32 and32768-byte source bound;1000 edits with warmup defined before measurement.
performance.targets: Inherited p95 preview<50ms, authoritative diagnostics<300ms. Record p50/p95/p99, reference CPU/RAM/OS/JDK/browser versions, sample count, cold/warm distinction and worker startup included/excluded.
performance.decision: Failure remains explicit gate failure; optimize or justify scope/target revision with evidence. A512-node cap or unit test is no substitute for latency measurement.
performance.measurement: Freeze actual fixture bytes/edit sequence before execution;100 warmup events then1000 measured events on declared host. Browser preview interval begins reducer dispatch and ends committed visual frame; authoritative diagnostic interval begins API request send and ends validated-response processing including network and worker startup. Record source/node counts and separate cold-start series. Browser absent leaves browser latency open; no synthetic substitution.

discipline: All authored Java/JS/TS production/tests/callbacks have meaningful Javadoc/JSDoc and<=30physical lines per callable; private encapsulated Java state, immutable/defensive DTO collections. Run existing AST style guards without dense-line/generated-code evasion.
release: OriginalG2/G3 claims close only with their own evidence. Browser/manual AT, commercial rights and market validation remain separately open.
